waiting_period_initial.value: A 30-day waiting period applies to all treatments, except for accidental injuries.
waiting_period_initial.clause: Clause 2.1: Initial Waiting Period Provision A waiting period of thirty (30) days from the inception date of this Policy shall apply to all medical and surgical treatments, except in case of accidental bodily injury occurring during the policy period. No claims for sickness or illness diagnosed within the initial 30 days shall be admissible under any circumstances.

waiting_period_preexisting.value: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 continuous months of health insurance coverage.
waiting_period_preexisting.clause: Clause 4.2: Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Moratorium Pre-Existing Diseases and their direct complications shall not be covered until 36 continuous months of health insurance coverage have elapsed since the inception of the first policy with us. Covered ailments diagnosed prior to inception shall remain uninsurable during this 3-year moratorium.

waiting_period_specific.value: A 24-month waiting period applies to specific conditions like cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement, and calculus diseases.
waiting_period_specific.clause: Clause 6.1: Specific Illnesses Waiting Period The expenses on treatment of the following specified illnesses and procedures: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement surgery, and calculus diseases shall be payable only after a waiting period of 24 months of continuous coverage under this policy.
